description: This PHP class 'PerformanceReviewService' provides methods for managing performance reviews within an HR management system. It includes functionalities such as creating, updating, activating reviews, and handling reviewer ratings, utilizing multiple traits and interacting with a DAO layer.

classes.name: PerformanceReviewService
classes.description: A service class for handling performance review operations such as creation, update, activation, and rating management within an HRM system.

methods.name: getPerformanceReviewDao
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns an instance of PerformanceReviewDao.

methods.name: activateReview
methods.description: Activates a performance review for an employee, given the review object and reviewer employee number.

methods.name: updateActivateReview
methods.description: Updates and activates an existing performance review, validating reviewer’s employment status and supervisor relationship.

methods.name: activateReviewCommonExceptions
methods.description: Checks for essential properties before activating a review, such as job title and KPI presence.

methods.name: saveAndUpdateReviewRatings
methods.description: Creates reviewer ratings from provided data and saves them via DAO.

methods.name: createRatingsFromRows
methods.description: Generates a list of ReviewerRating objects from raw input rows.

methods.name: generateReviewReviewerRatingKey
methods.description: Generates a unique key string based on reviewer ID, review ID, and KPI ID.
